title: laya-phase-4.1-decision-corpus-row
description: One row per mined historical decision-point candidate for Phase 4.1 corpus design. Approved schema per the corpus-design review: distinguishes decision-time information (decision_time_context, model_facing_input) from post-decision evidence (ground_truth_evidence, and for human_acceptance_required, empirical_basis). model_facing_input must be a controlled projection of decision_time_context -- every fact in it must be traceable there. No row here has been used for any Laya/model evaluation yet; this is data-contract validation only. 'schema_version' here is this corpus content schema's own version, distinct from the JSON Schema draft named by '$schema' -- it is validated by the Phase 4.2 corpus loader and by validate_corpus.py.

source_artifact.description: Exact file path and line number(s)/commit, per the mining audit -- never paraphrased away.

decision_time_context.description: Everything genuinely available before the decision (the 'A' information). model_facing_input must be derivable entirely from this object.

model_facing_input.description: The literal input a model would see. Must be a controlled projection of decision_time_context; must never contain any field from ground_truth_evidence or (for DP-23) empirical_basis.

ground_truth_label.description: Used by trivial_vs_staged, agent_verification_applicable, documented_limitation_vs_defect only. Always null for human_acceptance_required rows -- see normative_label/empirical_label instead.

corpus_partition.description: agent_verification_applicable only. Obvious cases must never be marked system1_judgment.

evidence_polarity.description: documented_limitation_vs_defect only. Must be reported/evaluated separately from each other -- never merged into one accuracy number.

evidence_source_type.description: documented_limitation_vs_defect only -- what kind of documentation was actually consulted.

normative_label.description: human_acceptance_required only. Whether the workflow/policy says acceptance is required -- never collapsed with empirical_label.

empirical_label.description: human_acceptance_required only. Whether a human actually reviewed/accepted/rejected the work -- independent of normative_label.

empirical_basis.description: The literal observed human response. Post-decision evidence -- must never appear in model_facing_input.

normative_empirical_relationship.description: human_acceptance_required only; derived, not independently asserted.

ground_truth_evidence.description: Post-decision evidence ('B' information). Never present in model_facing_input.

reused_evidence_of.description: candidate_id of another row sharing the same underlying source task, if any.

eligible_for_binary_scoring.description: False for every trivial_vs_staged row regardless of inclusion_status (single-class real coverage cannot support a binary accuracy score). False for include_as_borderline/exclude rows generally; true only for clean, include rows in decisions with real coverage of more than one class.
